subject: Latency incident — proposal for token safety-net + trial extension
messages:
From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@stellarsolutions.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Stellar Solutions Support <support@stellarsolutions.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual latency spikes this morning — request for remediation

Hi Laura,

We saw a spike in tail latency between 06:05–06:45 PT which caused ~12% of our inference requests to exceed the 1.2s P95 boundary. This hit two critical checkout flows and pushed errors into our metrics. Our engineering team pulled traces and have attached the incident summary.

Can Redwood propose a remediation package? Stellar is mid-trial and high-usage; we need a practical path so we can continue the pilot without reverting to our fallback. Short-term token credit + trial extension would be ideal.

Thanks,
Sam
Head of Platform — Stellar Solutions

Attachments: incident_report_20261008.pdf (pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@stellarsolutions.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual latency spikes this morning — request for remediation

Sam —

Thanks for sending the report and the quick detail. Sorry you ran into that disruption during the pilot window. We're reviewing traces from our side; initial indicators point to a transient autoscaler lag around a model shard evening ramp.

Proposed short-term remedy (for discussion):
- 100k prompt tokens + 900k completion tokens (1M token safety-net) applied to your account immediately as a good-faith make-good.
- 30-day trial extension from the current trial end date.
- We will run a complimentary performance tuning session with our SRE team to reduce tail latency risk (1-hour workshop).

I'll loop in Revenue Ops (Aditya) for the token top-up approval and Legal (Markus) in case we need a brief amendment. Marissa — can you confirm the economics (discount/cap) if they want to convert to a committed plan after the trial?

Laura
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_makegood_terms_20261009.xlsx (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unusual latency spikes this morning — request for remediation

Laura / team —

I ran a quick calc on deal health and typical conversion rates for similar pilots. Offering a 1M token safety-net + 30-day extension looks reasonable if we cap the one-time token credit to trial-only usage and mark it as non-refundable. If Stellar converts to a paid committed plan within 45 days, we can offer a one-time onboarding credit (up to 200k tokens) toward the first invoice.

Also recommend we include a short ROI note for Sam showing projected token consumption and per-token delta vs committed pricing — makes the value prop clearer.

Marissa
Senior Account Exec

Laura / Marissa —

Revenue Ops approves the 1,000,000 token safety-net under these constraints:
- Tokens applied as a one-time credit for trial usage only (not refundable).
- Token pool will be visible on the account and expire 60 days after issuance.
- Trial extension of 30 days approved; any committed-conversion incentives to be agreed by Sales.

I'll provision the credit once Legal confirms we don't need a signed addendum. Markus — can you confirm? If a simple DocuSign amendment is preferred, I can route the DocuSign link and mark finance approval.

Aditya
Revenue Operations

Subject: Re: Unusual latency spikes this morning — request for remediation

Team —

This is a low-risk amendment. I'm fine with a short electronic acknowledgement that documents the token credit and trial extension and states it does not alter underlying SLAs or payment obligations. DocuSign is fine for signature capture. Please ensure the acknowledgement explicitly states token expiration (60 days) and that tokens cannot be converted to monetary credits.

I'll review the acknowledgement draft; Laura / Aditya, loop me when you have the DocuSign ready.

Markus
Head of Legal
